parameters.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Draw ONE independently new full-body 08 alchemy prodigy boy walking sprite on a true transparent square canvas, native at least 1024x1024. Image1 is the primary SE standing pose, camera, proportions, costume and equipment anchor; image2 is original identity; image3 is only painted material/style, never draw its UI. Preserve Image1 exactly: rounded amber-eyed child face and chestnut high topknot with jade/gold clasp and two gold ribbons, orange-gold brocade robe with teal panels, ivory puffy trousers, green-gold boots with ivory toe caps, strapped herb basket with twin ivory scrolls, beads/pouch/tassels. Anatomical RIGHT hand holds the bronze-jade yin-yang censer on the NEAR arm on screen LEFT; LEFT hand holds potion on the FAR arm on screen RIGHT. Never switch hands or mirror the character. Same fixed slight top-down camera and SOUTH-EAST three-quarter FRONT view, face/torso/both boots directed down-right, arms quietly hold equipment. Keep original head/body size and short stout limbs, balanced gentle normal walking with a short stride, not marching, running, kicking, jumping or high knees. Most boot uppers visible; do not point a broad sole toward viewer. Preserve subject size and fixed ground origin, around84% canvas height, grounded sole y92%, safe empty margins. Redraw legs and corresponding cloth for this exact gait phase; do not reuse or shift an idle pose. Bright clean polished hand-painted Daoist chibi materials. Transparent alpha; no scenery, floor, shadow, halo, colored fringe, text, grid, labels, duplicate characters or sheet. Frame09 opposite contact. Draw NEAR anatomical RIGHT leg (censer side, viewer LEFT leg) taking the FORWARD grounded step, with its boot visibly in the foreground at BOTTOM CENTER/LEFT, the LOWEST boot. This near right thigh/knee leads and its shin descends to that low boot. Draw FAR anatomical LEFT leg (potion side, viewer RIGHT leg) trailing BEHIND: its boot is HIGHER on the canvas and to the RIGHT, with heel lifted and toe lightly on ground behind the pelvis. The two boots must switch their front/back depth compared with a left-foot-leading stride. Do not put the viewer-right boot at the lowest forward position. Short low natural walking contact, not idle, not high knee, no broad sole exposed. Preserve entire upper-body orientation and original equipment sides. Front boot near x52% y93%, rear boot near x68% y87%, approximate guides only; keep natural anatomy.
